mails.subject: Fwd: Renting a room for a day?
mails.body:
Hi team, can one of you take this one? I think they are a good fit for the big room.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Jonas Eriksen <jonas.eriksen@northwind-collective.example>
Date: 5 Oct 2026, 20:17
Subject: Renting a room for a day?

Hello,

I found your space through a friend who is a member there. I coordinate a small research network, about 14 people, and twice a year we gather for a full day of working sessions. So far we have used a university room, but it is no longer available to us.

I do not have a date yet. We are looking at sometime in November or early December, depending on when everyone can travel in from Aarhus and Odense. Before we start the scheduling, I would like to know whether a day rental is possible at all for a group our size.

We would need a table layout rather than rows, a screen to share slides, and ideally coffee and lunch, though we can sort lunch ourselves if you do not offer it.

Could you tell me what the rental conditions look like, the rough price for a full day, and how far in advance you usually need to be told? If it helps, I can send a short description of what we do.

Thank you in advance,
Jonas Eriksen
Northwind Collective
mails.justification: A visitor with no date asks if a room can be rented for a day, forwarded with a one-line comment, so room_booking, answer within the week.

mails.subject: Invoice 2026-0318, VAT number and card payment
mails.body:
Hello,

I have three questions about my account.

First, the invoice for September (2026-0318, 1,950 DKK) was sent without my company VAT number. My company is Holm Design ApS, VAT DK 12345678. Could you reissue it with the number? I need it for my bookkeeper before the end of the month.

Second, I noticed that the card payment for the 2 meeting room hours on 18 September (480 DKK) failed on my side, my bank sent a message saying it was declined. I do not know if this was a one-off. Could you tell me if the amount is still open, and send me a link to pay again?

Third, could you send me a receipt for the 1,950 DKK I paid by bank transfer on 3 September? I cannot find it in my emails.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Nanna Holm
Holm Design ApS
mails.justification: A member asks about adding a VAT number, a failed card payment and a receipt, so billing, answer within 24 hours, human reply needed.

mails.subject: Kvarter Nyt: Uge 40 i Nordhavn
mails.body:
Hej og tak, fordi du abonnerer på Kvarter Nyt.

Denne uge i kvarteret:
- Loppemarked på havnepladsen lørdag kl. 10 til 15.
- Ny cykelrute åbner mellem Nordhavn og stationen mandag.
- Biblioteket holder åbent til kl. 20 torsdag med oplæsning for børn.

Husk at tilmelde dig vores kvartersmøde den 15. oktober, hvor vi taler om byggeriet ved kajen.

Du modtager denne mail, fordi du har tilmeldt dig nyhedsbrevet. Afmeld nederst på siden.

Med venlig hilsen
Redaktionen

mails.subject: Re: Thank you for hosting the product demo night
mails.body:
Hi Freja and team,

Just a short note to close the loop. We got 41 sign-ups for the product demo night and about 30 showed up, which is better than we hoped for in a new venue. Several guests asked afterwards where we found the space and whether we do this regularly.

The room setup was perfect. The projector worked on the first try, the chairs were already arranged in the half circle we had asked for, and the coffee was ready before anyone arrived. Thank you also to whoever stayed late to help us stack the tables.

For your information, we have already sent the invoice for our part of the catering to our own accounting, so there is nothing more on your side. I will send the photos on Friday, in case you want to use them on your website. No need to answer this, I just wanted you to know it went well.

All the best,
Tobias
